headword: {厚生年金|こうせいねんきん}

definitions.explanation: Japan's public pension scheme for company employees and civil servants. Contributions are taken from salary and shared with the employer, and it pays a pension on top of the basic national pension.

examples.japanese: {厚生年金|こうせいねんきん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{加入|かにゅう}する→加入する：22671_kanyuusuru⟧。
examples.english: To join the employees' pension scheme.

examples.japanese: ⟦{給料|きゅうりょう}→給料：01086_kyuuryou⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{厚生年金|こうせいねんきん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{引|ひ}かれている→引く：01978_hiku⟧。
examples.english: Employees' pension contributions are deducted from my salary.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{辞|や}めて⟦フリーランス→フリーランス：06152_furiiransu⟧になった⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、{厚生年金|こうせいねんきん}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{国民年金|こくみんねんきん}→国民年金：23534_kokuminnenkin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{切|き}り{替|か}えた→切り替える：04239_kirikaeru⟧。
examples.english: I quit my company and became a freelancer, so I switched from the employees' pension to the national pension.

notes:
{厚生|こうせい} (public welfare) + ⟦{年金|ねんきん}→年金：04695_nenkin⟧ (pension). Japan's public pension has two layers: ⟦{国民年金|こくみんねんきん}→国民年金：23534_kokuminnenkin⟧, the basic pension everyone from 20 to 59 pays into, and {厚生年金|こうせいねんきん}, the extra layer for salaried workers. A salaried worker is enrolled in both automatically.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {厚生年金|こうせいねんきん}{保険料|ほけんりょう}: employees' pension contributions
- {厚生年金|こうせいねんきん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{加入|かにゅう}する→加入する：22671_kanyuusuru⟧: to be enrolled in the employees' pension
- {厚生年金|こうせいねんきん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}け{取|と}る→受け取る：01883_uketoru⟧: to receive an employees' pension

SIMILAR WORDS:
